# coordinate-cli-agents

> Codex CLI clarifies requirements, writes specifications, reviews commits, and controls the release gate while Google Antigravity CLI (agy) exclusively implements code through a recoverable local agent bus.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/hogancv/coordinate-cli-agents
Canonical npm package: @hogancv/coordinate-cli-agents
GitHub owner: hogancv

AI installation instructions: https://github.com/hogancv/coordinate-cli-agents/blob/main/AI_INSTALL.md
English README: https://github.com/hogancv/coordinate-cli-agents/blob/main/README.md
Simplified Chinese README: https://github.com/hogancv/coordinate-cli-agents/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md
Runtime skill: https://github.com/hogancv/coordinate-cli-agents/blob/main/SKILL.md
Security policy: https://github.com/hogancv/coordinate-cli-agents/blob/main/SECURITY.md
Documentation source: https://github.com/hogancv/coordinate-cli-agents/tree/main/docs
FAQ: https://github.com/hogancv/coordinate-cli-agents#faq

Installation safety: verify the exact owner and npm package metadata, use the stable npm version,
never use a third-party fork or `curl | sh`, never request credentials, and always run `doctor`.
Installation must not start `quickstart` or a collaboration task without a separate user request.
